$$PMT = \frac{P \cdot r}{1-(1+r)^{-n}} = \frac{20000 \times 0.005}{1-(1.005)^{-60}} = \frac{100}{0.258628} \approx 386.656$$

Rounded to the nearest cent, that's **$386.66** per month for 60 months (ignoring the extra $100 principal).

**$2,444.36**
